### cylinder2d

This app is the simplified version of $\texttt{laminar/cylinder2d}$. It contains the bare minimum code to execute the cylinder benchmark case with OpenLB. This example is suited to grasp the basic structure of OpenLB example cases.
This case is also used for the tutorial exercises at the OpenLB spring school.
